Description:
## Summary

Harden the existing `search_grounded_places` Mastra tool (used by `conciergeAgent` for restaurant/nightlife/cafe queries) to return structured results with opening hours, price level, and grounding sources — and ensure every Places API call uses `X-Goog-FieldMask`.

## Done when

- [ ] `search_grounded_places(query, domain, lat, lng)` returns `GroundedPlace[]` with: `id, displayName, formattedAddress, location, openNow, priceLevel, rating, grounding_source: "places_api"`
- [ ] Every Places API call in the tool uses `X-Goog-FieldMask: places.id,places.displayName,places.formattedAddress,places.location,places.currentOpeningHours,places.priceLevel,places.rating` — no `photos` unless explicitly needed
- [ ] `openNow` filter: agent passes `openNow: true` for queries like "open now" or "tonight" — uses `currentOpeningHours.openNow` field
- [ ] Results update `MdeState.mapPins[]` via `useCoAgent` — domain-colored pins per wireframe (Orange 🍽️, Brown ☕, Dark blue 🌙)
- [ ] `useCopilotAction({ name: "search_grounded_places", available: "disabled", render })` renders restaurant/cafe/nightlife cards in chat
- [ ] Vitest: tool returns ≥1 result for "quiet cafe Laureles", `grounding_source` = "places_api", `openNow` field present
- [ ] Faithfulness scorer (SAN-590) passes — agent cites place name from API response, not hallucinated

## Implementation notes

* Current implementation exists in `src/mastra/agents/index.ts` — this is a hardening + typing task, not a rewrite
* Domain → pin color mapping: `restaurant` → orange, `cafe` → brown, `nightlife` → dark_blue (matches `consumer/004-explore-map.md`)
* `openNow` on Places API New: use `currentOpeningHours.openNow` boolean (New API) — not legacy `opening_hours.open_now`
* For "vibe" queries ("rooftop with jazz"): combine Places `textSearch` with `keyword` parameter; return top 5, let agent rerank by vibe match

## Critical rules

* `X-Goog-FieldMask` on EVERY Places fetch — never fetch `places.photos` or `places.reviews` in this tool
* Map pin update via `useCoAgent` is required — not optional UI enhancement
* `openNow` must use real-time Places API value, not a cached/static field

Title: SEARCH-002 — Hybrid rental + event search with confidence score
Description:
## Summary

Extend `search_rentals` and `search_events` Mastra tools to blend Supabase full-text search with Places API grounding, returning a `confidence_score` and `grounding_sources[]` on each result. Agent can explain WHY a result was ranked first.

## Done when

- [ ] `search_rentals` returns `{ results: RentalResult[], grounding_sources: GroundingSource[] }` — sources list the Supabase row IDs and any Places API data that informed ranking
- [ ] `search_events` returns same shape
- [ ] Confidence score (0–100) on each result: `{ ...result, confidence: 87, confidence_reason: "Exact neighborhood + price match" }`
- [ ] Agent uses `grounding_sources` to answer "why did you show me this?" — not hallucinated reasons
- [ ] `useCopilotReadable({ value: groundingSources })` exposes sources to CopilotKit so chat can cite them
- [ ] Vitest: grounding sources array is non-empty for any result with a Google Places enrichment
- [ ] Faithfulness scorer (SAN-590 AGT-00A) passes on grounded replies

## Implementation notes

* Supabase FTS: `to_tsvector('english', title || ' ' || description)` + `plainto_tsquery` for natural language queries
* Places grounding: for rentals, match neighborhood to Places API `addressComponents`; for events, match venue name to `displayName`
* Confidence formula: `base_score(FTS rank) * location_match_bonus * price_match_bonus` — normalize to 0–100
* `GroundingSource` type: `{ source_type: "supabase" | "places_api", entity_id: string, field: string, value: string }`
* Anti-hallucination: if `grounding_sources` is empty, agent MUST NOT claim a specific location attribute — fall back to "based on listing description"

## Critical rules

* `X-Goog-FieldMask` required on every Places API call in the grounding layer
* Grounding sources must be verifiable at runtime — no static/cached reasoning strings passed as sources
* SAN-590 (faithfulness scorer) must pass before this ships — grounding without a scorer is unguarded

Title: MAP-005 — Places cache cost audit: FieldMask enforcement + caching layer
Description:
## Summary

Audit every Places API New call in `src/mastra/` and `src/app/api/` for `X-Goog-FieldMask` compliance, then add a caching layer to prevent redundant billing on repeated venue/restaurant lookups.

## Done when

- [ ] `grep -r "places.googleapis.com" src/` lists every call site; each has `X-Goog-FieldMask` with a field-level list (never `*`)
- [ ] Fields scoped to the minimum needed per surface:
  - Venue search: `places.id,places.displayName,places.formattedAddress,places.location,places.rating`
  - Explore pins: `places.id,places.displayName,places.location`
  - Restaurant detail: `places.id,places.displayName,places.formattedAddress,places.regularOpeningHours,places.priceLevel`
- [ ] Caching: Upstash Redis or `unstable_cache` (Next.js) wraps Places fetch with 24h TTL keyed by `placeId + fieldMask hash`
- [ ] Vitest test: any `fetch` to `places.googleapis.com` without `X-Goog-FieldMask` fails the suite
- [ ] Billing before/after documented in `docs/maps/places-cache-audit.md`

## Implementation notes

* Fetching `photos` SKU costs 7× more than `displayName` — each unused field is a cost landmine
* Cache key: `sha256(placeId + sortedFields)` → store in Upstash with `EX 86400`
* `search_grounded_places` tool in `conciergeAgent` is the highest-volume caller — prioritize that first
* Cost formula: if `search_grounded_places` fires 10× per session for 1,000 DAU = 10,000 calls/day → `places.photos` vs `places.id,displayName,location` is \~$70/day vs $1/day at scale

## Critical rules

* `X-Goog-FieldMask` is a hard rule in CLAUDE.md — treat missing mask as a billing P0
* Never fetch `places.reviews` or `places.photos` unless the UI component displaying them ships in the same PR
* Caching must NOT cache error responses or empty results

## References

* CLAUDE.md: "Every Places API New call: `X-Goog-FieldMask` (cost lever)"
* Skill: `.claude/skills/mde-maps`
* Related: INFRA-001 FieldMask audit (SAN-753), venueAgent MAP-010

Title: VEC-002 — Semantic rerank: cosine similarity reranking for rental + event search
Description:
## Summary

After VEC-001 ships, add a semantic rerank step to `search_rentals` and `search_events`: embed the user's query at runtime, call `match_embeddings`, and merge cosine-similarity rank with the Supabase FTS rank for a blended final score. Camila gets results ordered by actual preference match, not just keyword overlap.

## Done when

- [ ] `search_rentals` accepts `semantic: true` flag; when set, embeds `query` string via Gemini, calls `match_embeddings("rental", query_embedding, 20)`, merges with FTS top-20, returns blended top-10
- [ ] Blended score formula: `0.6 * cosine_score + 0.4 * fts_rank` — tunable via env var `SEMANTIC_WEIGHT` (default 0.6)
- [ ] Working memory boost: if user has `preferences.neighborhoods = ["Laureles"]`, results in Laureles get `+0.1` score bonus
- [ ] `search_events` same pattern: semantic + FTS blend with genre preference boost from working memory
- [ ] Vitest: for query "quiet furnished apartment with fast wifi", semantic result ranks a listing with "furnished, 300Mbps" in description above a cheaper listing without those terms
- [ ] Latency guard: rerank adds < 300ms p95 to tool response time (embedding is \~100ms, `match_embeddings` with HNSW < 50ms)
- [ ] Blocked by: VEC-001 (SAN-787) — `embeddings` table + `match_embeddings` function must exist

## Implementation notes

* Runtime embedding: `gemini-embedding-004` via `ai` SDK (`embed` from `@ai-sdk/google`) — same credential as agent
* Blended score: normalize FTS rank to 0–1 before mixing (`fts_rank / max_rank`)
* `SEMANTIC_WEIGHT`: expose as env var so A/B testing is possible without code change
* Cache query embedding: same query string in the same session returns cached embedding (no re-embed for pagination)
* For working memory boost: read `MdeState.preferences.neighborhoods` from agent context — already available via `useCoAgent`

## Critical rules

* Semantic rerank is additive — if `match_embeddings` fails (cold start, extension not loaded), fall back to FTS-only result; never throw
* Blocked by VEC-001 — do not start before `embeddings` table and HNSW index exist
* No `@anthropic-ai/sdk` — Gemini embedding only

Title: VEC-001 — pgvector foundation: embeddings table + backfill for rentals + events
Description:
## Summary

Enable the `pgvector` extension on Supabase, create an `embeddings` table, and run a backfill job that embeds all active rental and event descriptions using Gemini's text embedding model. Foundation for semantic search and reranking.

## Done when

- [ ] `pgvector` extension enabled on Supabase project `zkwcbyxiwklihegjhuql` (`CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector`)
- [ ] `embeddings` table: `(id uuid PK, entity_type text, entity_id uuid FK, embedding vector(768), model text, created_at timestamptz)`
- [ ] RLS: only service-role can INSERT/UPDATE; anon + authenticated can SELECT (needed for similarity queries)
- [ ] Backfill script at `scripts/backfill-embeddings.ts`: iterates `rentals WHERE status = 'available'` and `events WHERE status = 'published'`, calls `gemini-embedding-004` (or equivalent), inserts rows
- [ ] HNSW index: `CREATE INDEX ON embeddings USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops)` for fast ANN queries
- [ ] `match_embeddings(query_embedding, entity_type, limit)` Supabase function returns ranked `entity_id[]`
- [ ] Vitest: `match_embeddings` returns ≥1 result for a known rental query ("2BR Laureles furnished")
- [ ] Migration at `supabase/migrations/YYYYMMDD_pgvector_embeddings.sql`

## Implementation notes

* Embedding model: use `gemini-embedding-004` (768 dimensions) via `GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY` — same key as agents; no new credential needed
* Embed: `title + ' ' + description + ' ' + neighborhood` for rentals; `title + ' ' + description + ' ' + venue_name` for events
* Backfill: batch 50 rows at a time; rate-limit to 10 req/s to avoid Gemini quota
* `match_embeddings` SQL: `SELECT entity_id FROM embeddings WHERE entity_type = $1 ORDER BY embedding <=> $2 LIMIT $3`
* Incremental updates: trigger on INSERT/UPDATE of `rentals` and `events` tables → call edge function to embed + upsert

## Critical rules
